generation.scope: For every quantum background with four distinct oriented face parameters the entire attraction fiber is its single indexed orbit. With exactly one repeated nonunit face pair, every window over it has an explicit three-coefficient PBW normal form changing only one relation. Support and one scalar ratio classify all special values, up to reversal of the support when the repeated value is minus one. Every window in these fibers is regular and has exact period one.

open_mathematics: Complete the description of quantum attraction fibers at higher face multiplicities, especially triple faces and simultaneous corrections, and continue covering windows without a quantum orbit limit.
